```{r config}
# ---- Input files (edit to match your local copy) ------------------------------
DATA_DIR    <- "results/clin_default"
FILE_POST   <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "merged_rectangle_summary_euclidean.xlsx")     # post-SRI, Euclidean (primary)
FILE_PRE    <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "merged_rectangle_summary_euclidean_pre.xlsx") # pre-ablation (Figure 3)
FILE_GEO    <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "merged_rectangle_summary_geodesic.xlsx")      # post-SRI, geodesic (sensitivity)
FILE_AUTO   <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "auto_y.txt")    # automated geodesic distances (validation subset)
FILE_MANUAL <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "manual_y.txt")  # manual distances, same points in the same order

# ---- Outputs -------------------------------------------------------------------
OUT_DIR   <- "output"
FIG_DIR   <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "figures")
TAB_DIR   <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "tables")
CACHE_DIR <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "cache")
for (d in c(FIG_DIR, TAB_DIR, CACHE_DIR)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

SAVE_FIGURES    <- TRUE
FIG_DPI         <- 1200
RUN_SENSITIVITY <- TRUE   # untruncated data + geodesic distance (re-runs all models)
USE_CACHE       <- TRUE   # re-use saved Bayesian fits when data and settings are unchanged

# ---- Analysis constants (Methods) ----------------------------------------------
BOUNDARY_OFFSET   <- 3      # mm, scar boundary relative to the lesion-centre line
ROI_HEALTHY       <- 10     # mm analysed on the healthy side of the boundary
ROI_SCAR          <- 15     # mm analysed into the scar
DETECTION_LIMIT   <- 0.01   # mV, system limit of detection (points <= this are excluded)
TRIM_Q            <- 0.999  # upper-percentile truncation of voltage and peak frequency
SCAR_THRESHOLD_MV <- 0.05   # conventional electrical-scar threshold
ROC_HALF_WIDTH    <- 5      # mm either side of the scar boundary for ROC analysis

# Bayesian piecewise regression (mcp). These equal the mcp defaults:
# 3 chains x 3000 iterations = 9000 posterior draws, weakly informative default priors
# (see Supplemental Methods 3). cores = 3 runs the chains in parallel and, unlike the
# sequential default, makes results reproducible with set.seed().
MCP_CHAINS <- 3
MCP_ITER   <- 3000
MCP_ADAPT  <- 1500
MCP_SEED   <- 3

# ---- Labels and colours ----------------------------------------------------------
ELECTRODES <- c("Unipolar", "Bipolar", "Omnipolar")
LOCATIONS  <- c("Inferior", "Roof")
COLORS     <- c(Unipolar = "#0072B2", Bipolar = "#D55E00", Omnipolar = "#009E73")
```

## Helper functions

```{r helpers}
# ---- Data preparation -----------------------------------------------------------
read_map <- function(path) {
  read_excel(path) %>%
    mutate(
      patientID = factor(patientID),
      Location  = factor(if_else(inf0_roof1 == 0, "Inferior", "Roof"), levels = LOCATIONS),
      Electrode = factor(ELECTRODES[uni1_bi2_omni3], levels = ELECTRODES),
      Dist      = DistAcrossPath + BOUNDARY_OFFSET,          # 0 = scar boundary, > 0 = scar
      PP_log    = log(PP),
      PFreq_log = if_else(!is.na(PFreq) & PFreq > 0, log(PFreq), NA_real_)
    )
}

in_roi  <- function(d) filter(d, Dist > -ROI_HEALTHY, Dist < ROI_SCAR)
freq_ok <- function(d) filter(d, Electrode != "Unipolar", !is.na(PFreq), PFreq > 0,
                              PP > DETECTION_LIMIT)

# Remove values above the 99.9th percentile. Percentiles are computed on the data
# passed in; NA values (unipolar peak frequency) are kept.
trim_upper <- function(d, vars, trim = TRUE) {
  if (!trim) return(d)
  keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(d))
  for (v in vars) {
    q <- quantile(d[[v]], TRIM_Q, na.rm = TRUE)
    keep <- keep & (is.na(d[[v]]) | d[[v]] <= q)
  }
  d[keep, ]
}

# Analysis datasets. trim = FALSE gives the untruncated sensitivity datasets.
make_datasets <- function(raw, trim = TRUE) {
  list(
    # Full region of interest (-10 to 15 mm): sample flow, Table 2, ROC, Figure 3
    all      = raw %>% in_roi() %>% filter(PP > DETECTION_LIMIT) %>%
                 trim_upper(c("PP", "PFreq"), trim),
    # Scar region (0 to 15 mm): voltage decay models
    volt     = raw %>% filter(Dist > 0, Dist < ROI_SCAR, PP > DETECTION_LIMIT) %>%
                 trim_upper("PP", trim),
    # Scar region (0 to 15 mm): peak frequency decay models (bipolar/omnipolar only)
    freq     = raw %>% freq_ok() %>% filter(Dist >= 0, Dist <= ROI_SCAR) %>%
                 trim_upper(c("PFreq", "PP"), trim),
    # Full region of interest: peak frequency distributions, PPV, Figure 3
    freq_roi = raw %>% freq_ok() %>% in_roi() %>% trim_upper(c("PFreq", "PP"), trim)
  )
}

tissue_of <- function(dist) factor(if_else(dist <= 0, "Healthy", "Scar"),
                                   levels = c("Healthy", "Scar"))

# ---- Formatting / saving --------------------------------------------------------
fmt_p   <- function(p) ifelse(p < 1e-4, "<0.0001", sprintf("%.4f", p))
med_iqr <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  if (length(x) == 0) return("-")
  q <- quantile(x, c(0.5, 0.25, 0.75), names = FALSE)
  sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f (%.", digits, "f to %.", digits, "f)"), q[1], q[2], q[3])
}
show <- function(x, digits = 3, ...) knitr::kable(x, digits = digits, ...)
save_table <- function(x, name) {
  write.csv(x, file.path(TAB_DIR, paste0(name, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  invisible(x)
}
save_figure <- function(plot, name, width, height) {
  if (!SAVE_FIGURES) return(invisible(NULL))
  ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot,
         width = width, height = height, units = "in", bg = "white")
  ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(name, ".tiff")), plot,
         width = width, height = height, units = "in", dpi = FIG_DPI,
         compression = "lzw", bg = "white")
}

# Cache expensive results; the key includes the inputs, so stale fits are never reused.
cached <- function(key_obj, prefix, expr) {
  f <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(prefix, "_", rlang::hash(key_obj), ".rds"))
  if (USE_CACHE && file.exists(f)) return(readRDS(f))
  value <- expr
  if (USE_CACHE) saveRDS(value, f)
  value
}
```

```{r model-functions}
# ---- Mixed-effects decay models ---------------------------------------------------
# Exponential: ln(Y) = b0 + b1 * d      + u_i + e
# Power-law:   ln(Y) = b0 + b1 * ln(d)  + u_i + e
DECAY_MODELS <- c("Exponential", "Power-law")
decay_term    <- function(model) if (model == "Exponential") "Dist" else "log(Dist)"
decay_formula <- function(outcome, model, random = "(1 | patientID)") {
  as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", decay_term(model), "+", random))
}

# Model selection: both forms fitted by ML on identical data (d > 0), compared by AIC.
select_decay_model <- function(d, outcome) {
  d <- filter(d, Dist > 0)
  map_dfr(DECAY_MODELS, function(m) {
    fit <- lmer(decay_formula(outcome, m), data = d, REML = FALSE)
    tibble(model = m, n = nobs(fit), AIC = AIC(fit), BIC = BIC(fit))
  }) %>%
    mutate(dAIC = AIC - min(AIC), best = dAIC == 0)
}

# Final model: REML estimates of the selected form.
fit_decay_reml <- function(d, outcome, model) {
  if (model == "Power-law") d <- filter(d, Dist > 0)
  lmer(decay_formula(outcome, model), data = d, REML = TRUE)
}

tidy_decay <- function(fit, model) {
  term <- decay_term(model)
  ci   <- confint(fit, parm = c("(Intercept)", term), method = "Wald")
  r2   <- performance::r2(fit)
  b    <- lme4::fixef(fit)
  tibble(
    model = model, n = nobs(fit),
    b0 = b[[1]], b0_lower = ci[1, 1], b0_upper = ci[1, 2],
    b1 = b[[term]], b1_lower = ci[2, 1], b1_upper = ci[2, 2],
    p_b1 = summary(fit)$coefficients[term, "Pr(>|t|)"],
    A    = exp(b[[1]]),   # boundary value (exponential) or value at d = 1 mm (power-law)
    R2m  = r2$R2_marginal, R2c = r2$R2_conditional,
    RMSE = performance::rmse(fit)
  )
}

equation_label <- function(metric, model, A, b1) {
  y <- if (metric == "Voltage") "V" else "f"
  if (model == "Exponential") sprintf("%s = %.2f e^(%.2f d)", y, A, b1)
  else sprintf("%s = %.2f d^(%.2f)", y, A, b1)
}

# Population-level prediction with a 95% CI from the fixed-effect covariance matrix.
predict_decay <- function(fit, model, dist) {
  X   <- cbind(1, if (model == "Power-law") log(dist) else dist)
  eta <- drop(X %*% lme4::fixef(fit))
  se  <- sqrt(rowSums((X %*% as.matrix(vcov(fit))) * X))
  tibble(Dist = dist, value = exp(eta), lo = exp(eta - 1.96 * se), hi = exp(eta + 1.96 * se))
}

# Random-slope structure check (Supplemental Methods 2).
check_random_slope <- function(d, outcome, model) {
  if (model == "Power-law") d <- filter(d, Dist > 0)
  term <- decay_term(model)
  f    <- decay_formula(outcome, model, random = paste0("(1 + ", term, " | patientID)"))
  msgs <- character()
  fit  <- withCallingHandlers(
    tryCatch(lmer(f, data = d, REML = FALSE),
             error = function(e) { msgs <<- c(msgs, conditionMessage(e)); NULL }),
    warning = function(w) { msgs <<- c(msgs, conditionMessage(w)); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") }
  )
  status <- if (is.null(fit)) "Error"
            else if (length(msgs) > 0) "Convergence warning"
            else if (isSingular(fit)) "Singular fit"
            else "Converged"
  tibble(model = model, status = status, message = paste(unique(msgs), collapse = " | "))
}

# ---- Bayesian piecewise regression (linear decay + zero-slope plateau) --------------
fit_piecewise <- function(d, outcome, model, label) {
  d <- d %>%
    mutate(x = if (model == "Power-law") log(Dist) else Dist) %>%
    filter(is.finite(x), is.finite(.data[[outcome]]))
  d <- as.data.frame(d[, c(outcome, "x")])
  cached(list(d, outcome, MCP_CHAINS, MCP_ITER, MCP_ADAPT, MCP_SEED), paste0("mcp_", label), {
    set.seed(MCP_SEED)
    mcp(list(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ 1 + x")), ~ 0), data = d, par_x = "x",
        chains = MCP_CHAINS, iter = MCP_ITER, adapt = MCP_ADAPT, cores = MCP_CHAINS)
  })
}

# Posterior summaries (mean and 95% highest-density interval, as in mcp::summary),
# plus derived quantities computed draw-by-draw.
summarise_piecewise <- function(fit, model, metric) {
  s <- NULL
  invisible(capture.output(s <- summary(fit)))
  labels <- c(int_1 = "beta0", x_1 = "beta1", cp_1 = "cp", sigma_1 = "sigma")
  params <- tibble(term = unname(labels[s$name]), mean = s$mean, lower = s$lower,
                   upper = s$upper, Rhat = s$Rhat, n_eff = s$n.eff)

  draws <- do.call(rbind, lapply(fit$mcmc_post, as.matrix))
  b0 <- draws[, "int_1"]; b1 <- draws[, "x_1"]; cp <- draws[, "cp_1"]
  to_mm <- if (model == "Power-law") exp else identity
  hdi <- function(x, term) {
    h <- ggdist::mean_hdci(x, .width = 0.95)
    tibble(term = term, mean = h$y, lower = h$ymin, upper = h$ymax)
  }
  derived <- bind_rows(
    hdi(to_mm(cp), "cp_mm"),               # change point on the mm scale (cp' for power-law)
    hdi(exp(b0 + b1 * cp), "value_at_cp")  # signal level at the change point (mV or Hz)
  )
  if (metric == "Voltage") {
    d05 <- to_mm((log(SCAR_THRESHOLD_MV) - b0) / b1)  # distance where the decay segment hits 0.05 mV
    derived <- bind_rows(derived, hdi(d05, "dist_to_0.05mV"),
                         tibble(term = "P(0.05mV reached before cp)", mean = mean(d05 <= to_mm(cp))))
  }
  bind_rows(params, derived)
}

# ---- Full core analysis (used for the primary and all sensitivity analyses) ---------
build_specs <- function(ds) {
  bind_rows(
    ds$volt %>% distinct(Location, Electrode) %>%
      mutate(Metric = "Voltage", outcome = "PP_log", source = "volt"),
    ds$freq %>% distinct(Location, Electrode) %>%
      mutate(Metric = "Peak frequency", outcome = "PFreq_log", source = "freq")
  ) %>%
    mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, levels = c("Voltage", "Peak frequency"))) %>%
    arrange(Location, Metric, Electrode) %>%
    mutate(data = pmap(list(source, Location, Electrode),
                       function(s, l, e) filter(ds[[s]], Location == l, Electrode == e)))
}

run_core <- function(ds, label) {
  keys  <- c("Location", "Metric", "Electrode")
  specs <- build_specs(ds)

  selection <- specs %>%
    mutate(sel = map2(data, outcome, select_decay_model)) %>%
    select(all_of(keys), sel) %>% unnest(sel)

  specs <- specs %>%
    left_join(selection %>% filter(best) %>% select(all_of(keys), model), by = keys) %>%
    mutate(
      fit_reml = pmap(list(data, outcome, model), fit_decay_reml),
      fit_mcp  = pmap(list(data, outcome, model), fit_piecewise, label = label)
    )

  reml <- specs %>%
    mutate(t = map2(fit_reml, model, tidy_decay)) %>%
    select(all_of(keys), t) %>% unnest(t) %>%
    mutate(equation = pmap_chr(list(as.character(Metric), model, A, b1), equation_label))

  bayes <- specs %>%
    mutate(t = pmap(list(fit_mcp, model, as.character(Metric)), summarise_piecewise)) %>%
    select(all_of(keys), model, t) %>% unnest(t)

  list(label = label, specs = specs, selection = selection, reml = reml, bayes = bayes)
}

# Compare a sensitivity run with the primary run.
compare_to_primary <- function(prim, sens) {
  keys <- c("Location", "Metric", "Electrode")
  models <- prim$reml %>% select(all_of(keys), model_primary = model) %>%
    left_join(sens$reml %>% select(all_of(keys), model_sens = model), by = keys)
  sens_dAIC <- sens$selection %>% filter(!best) %>% select(all_of(keys), dAIC_sens = dAIC)

  slopes <- prim$reml %>% select(all_of(keys), b1, b1_lower, b1_upper) %>%
    left_join(sens$reml %>% select(all_of(keys), b1_sens = b1, b1_sens_lower = b1_lower,
                                   b1_sens_upper = b1_upper), by = keys)
  cps <- prim$bayes %>% filter(term == "cp_mm") %>%
    select(all_of(keys), cp = mean, cp_lower = lower, cp_upper = upper) %>%
    left_join(sens$bayes %>% filter(term == "cp_mm") %>%
                select(all_of(keys), cp_sens = mean, cp_sens_lower = lower,
                       cp_sens_upper = upper), by = keys)

  models %>% left_join(sens_dAIC, by = keys) %>%
    left_join(slopes, by = keys) %>% left_join(cps, by = keys) %>%
    mutate(
      same_model        = model_primary == model_sens,
      b1_within_prim_CI = same_model & b1_sens >= b1_lower & b1_sens <= b1_upper,
      cp_within_prim_CrI = cp_sens >= cp_lower & cp_sens <= cp_upper
    )
}
```

```{r data}
raw_post <- read_map(FILE_POST)
raw_pre  <- read_map(FILE_PRE)
ds       <- make_datasets(raw_post)
```

Methods / Results "Electroanatomical Mapping Data": points in the region of interest, exclusions, and points per patient.

```{r sample-flow}
roi      <- in_roi(raw_post)
above_dl <- filter(roi, PP > DETECTION_LIMIT)
bo_all   <- filter(ds$all, Electrode != "Unipolar")
n_undet  <- sum(is.na(bo_all$PFreq) | bo_all$PFreq == 0)

sample_flow <- tribble(
  ~Step,                                                   ~n,
  "Mapping points in region of interest (-10 to 15 mm)",   nrow(roi),
  "Excluded: below limit of detection (<= 0.01 mV)",       sum(roi$PP <= DETECTION_LIMIT),
  "Excluded: above 99.9th percentile (voltage or PF)",     nrow(above_dl) - nrow(ds$all),
  "Voltage analysis",                                      nrow(ds$all),
  "Bipolar + omnipolar points (PF available)",             nrow(bo_all),
  "Excluded: undetectable peak frequency",                 n_undet,
  "Peak frequency analysis",                               nrow(bo_all) - n_undet
)
show(sample_flow)

cat("99.9th percentile thresholds (region of interest): PP =",
    round(quantile(above_dl$PP, TRIM_Q), 3), "mV; PFreq =",
    round(quantile(above_dl$PFreq, TRIM_Q, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "Hz\n")

per_patient <- count(roi, patientID, name = "n_points")
cat(sprintf("Points per patient: median %.0f (IQR %.0f to %.0f)\n",
            median(per_patient$n_points), quantile(per_patient$n_points, 0.25),
            quantile(per_patient$n_points, 0.75)))

# Size of each analysis dataset
bind_rows(lapply(ds, function(d) count(d, Location, Electrode)), .id = "dataset") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dataset, values_from = n) %>% show()
```

# Voltage and peak frequency in healthy and scar tissue

## Table 2

Healthy = distance <= 0 mm (outside the scar boundary), scar = distance > 0 mm. Peak frequency summaries exclude undetectable values (PF = 0).

```{r table2}
table2 <- ds$all %>%
  mutate(Tissue = tissue_of(Dist)) %>%
  group_by(Location, Electrode, Tissue) %>%
  summarise(
    n_voltage = n(),
    Voltage   = med_iqr(PP),
    n_PF      = sum(PFreq > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    PeakFreq  = med_iqr(PFreq[!is.na(PFreq) & PFreq > 0]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Tissue, values_from = c(n_voltage, Voltage, n_PF, PeakFreq))

show(table2)
save_table(table2, "Table2_voltage_PF_by_tissue")
```

## Normality and group comparisons (Supplemental Results 1)

```{r normality}
# Shapiro-Wilk
ds$all %>%
  mutate(Tissue = tissue_of(Dist)) %>%
  group_by(Location, Electrode, Tissue) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            W = if (n() >= 3 && n() <= 5000) shapiro.test(PP)$statistic else NA_real_,
            p = if (n() >= 3 && n() <= 5000) fmt_p(shapiro.test(PP)$p.value) else NA_character_,
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  show()
```

```{r voltage-comparisons}
volt_tissue <- mutate(ds$all, Tissue = tissue_of(Dist))

# Inferior wall vs roof (Mann-Whitney U), by tissue and electrode
inf_vs_roof <- volt_tissue %>%
  group_by(Tissue, Electrode) %>%
  summarise(p = wilcox.test(PP[Location == "Inferior"], PP[Location == "Roof"])$p.value,
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(p = fmt_p(p))
show(inf_vs_roof)
save_table(inf_vs_roof, "SuppResults1_inferior_vs_roof")

# Electrode configurations (Kruskal-Wallis + Dunn, Holm-corrected), by tissue
for (tissue in levels(volt_tissue$Tissue)) {
  d  <- filter(volt_tissue, Tissue == tissue)
  kw <- kruskal.test(PP ~ Electrode, data = d)
  cat(sprintf("\n%s tissue: Kruskal-Wallis p = %s\n", tissue, fmt_p(kw$p.value)))
  dunn <- dunnTest(PP ~ Electrode, data = d, method = "holm")$res
  print(show(mutate(dunn, P.adj = fmt_p(P.adj)) %>% select(Comparison, Z, P.adj)))
}
```

# Primary analysis: decay models

```{r primary-run}
primary <- run_core(ds, label = "primary")
```

## Model selection (ML, AIC)

```{r model-selection}
selection_wide <- primary$selection %>%
  select(Location, Metric, Electrode, model, AIC) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = AIC, names_prefix = "AIC_") %>%
  left_join(primary$selection %>% filter(best) %>% select(Location, Metric, Electrode, best_model = model),
            by = c("Location", "Metric", "Electrode")) %>%
  mutate(dAIC = abs(`AIC_Exponential` - `AIC_Power-law`))
show(selection_wide, digits = 1)
save_table(selection_wide, "ModelSelection_AIC")

# Functional forms reported in the manuscript
expected <- tribble(
  ~Metric,          ~Electrode,  ~expected,
  "Voltage",        "Unipolar",  "Power-law",
  "Voltage",        "Bipolar",   "Exponential",
  "Voltage",        "Omnipolar", "Exponential",
  "Peak frequency", "Bipolar",   "Exponential",
  "Peak frequency", "Omnipolar", "Exponential"
)
mismatch <- selection_wide %>%
  mutate(Metric = as.character(Metric), Electrode = as.character(Electrode)) %>%
  left_join(expected, by = c("Metric", "Electrode")) %>%
  filter(best_model != expected)
if (nrow(mismatch) > 0) warning("Selected model differs from the manuscript for: ",
                                paste(mismatch$Location, mismatch$Metric, mismatch$Electrode, collapse = "; "))
```

# Bayesian piecewise models

## Table 5 and Supplemental Results 5

`cp` is on the model scale (log-distance for unipolar); `cp_mm` is the change point in mm (cp' for unipolar), i.e. the effective field of view (voltage) or the transition boundary (peak frequency). `value_at_cp` is the voltage (mV) or peak frequency (Hz) at the change point.

```{r table5}
table5 <- primary$bayes %>%
  filter(term %in% c("beta0", "beta1", "cp", "cp_mm", "sigma"),
         !(term == "cp_mm" & model == "Exponential")) %>%
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = c("beta0", "beta1", "cp", "cp_mm", "sigma"))) %>%
  arrange(Location, Metric, Electrode, term)
show(table5, digits = 2)
save_table(table5, "Table5_bayesian_posteriors")

cat("Max Rhat across all parameters:", round(max(table5$Rhat, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    " | Min n_eff:", min(table5$n_eff, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

change_points <- primary$bayes %>%
  filter(term %in% c("cp_mm", "value_at_cp")) %>%
  select(Location, Metric, Electrode, term, mean, lower, upper) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = c(mean, lower, upper), names_glue = "{term}_{.value}")
show(change_points, digits = 2)
save_table(change_points, "SuppResults5_change_points")

# Look-up tables used below
efov <- primary$bayes %>%
  filter(Metric == "Voltage", term == "cp_mm") %>%
  select(Location, Electrode, EFOV = mean)
pf_cp_value <- primary$bayes %>%
  filter(Metric == "Peak frequency", term == "value_at_cp") %>%
  transmute(Location, Electrode, PF_threshold = round(mean))
```

## Distance at which voltage reaches 0.05 mV

Estimated from the decay segment of the Bayesian piecewise model. If the voltage at the change point is above 0.05 mV, the threshold is not reached within the decay segment.

```{r threshold-0.05}
threshold_005 <- primary$bayes %>%
  filter(Metric == "Voltage", Electrode != "Unipolar",  # not reported for unipolar (log-distance extrapolation)
         term %in% c("dist_to_0.05mV", "P(0.05mV reached before cp)", "cp_mm", "value_at_cp")) %>%
  select(Location, Electrode, term, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = mean)
show(threshold_005, digits = 2)
save_table(threshold_005, "Threshold_0.05mV_distance")
```

## Table 4: decay distances (bipolar and omnipolar)

Distances at which voltage and peak frequency fall to 90%, 70% and 50% of their boundary value (REML exponential models), and the fraction of the boundary value remaining at a distance equal to the voltage effective field of view (table footnote).

```{r table4}
table4 <- primary$reml %>%
  filter(model == "Exponential", Electrode != "Unipolar") %>%
  left_join(efov, by = c("Location", "Electrode")) %>%
  transmute(Location, Metric, Electrode,
            boundary_value = A,
            d_90pct = log(0.9) / b1, d_70pct = log(0.7) / b1, d_50pct = log(0.5) / b1,
            EFOV, remaining_at_EFOV = exp(b1 * EFOV))
show(table4, digits = 2)
save_table(table4, "Table4_decay_distances")
```

## Peak frequency beyond the effective field of view (Supplemental Results 8)

```{r pf-regions}
pf_regions <- ds$freq_roi %>%
  left_join(efov, by = c("Location", "Electrode")) %>%
  mutate(Region = factor(case_when(Dist <= 0    ~ "Healthy side",
                                   Dist <= EFOV ~ "Boundary to EFOV",
                                   TRUE         ~ "Beyond EFOV"),
                         levels = c("Healthy side", "Boundary to EFOV", "Beyond EFOV"))) %>%
  group_by(Location, Electrode, Region) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), median = median(PFreq), Q1 = quantile(PFreq, 0.25),
            Q3 = quantile(PFreq, 0.75), p95 = quantile(PFreq, 0.95), .groups = "drop")
show(pf_regions, digits = 0)
save_table(pf_regions, "SuppResults8_PF_by_region")

# PPV of peak frequency below the change-point value for identifying scar (distance > 0)
ppv_pf <- ds$freq_roi %>%
  left_join(pf_cp_value, by = c("Location", "Electrode")) %>%
  group_by(Location, Electrode) %>%
  summarise(PF_threshold   = first(PF_threshold),
            n_pred_scar    = sum(PFreq < PF_threshold),
            n_true_pos     = sum(PFreq < PF_threshold & Dist > 0),
            PPV_pct        = 100 * n_true_pos / n_pred_scar, .groups = "drop")
show(ppv_pf, digits = 1)
save_table(ppv_pf, "SuppResults8_PPV_at_PF_change_point")
```

# Discriminatory performance across the scar boundary (Supplemental Results 7)

Points within 5 mm either side of the scar boundary; healthy = distance <= 0, scar = distance > 0. Lower values predict scar; optimal thresholds by the Youden index.

```{r roc}
run_roc <- function(x, label) {
  roc_obj <- roc(label, x, levels = c(0, 1), direction = ">", quiet = TRUE)
  best <- coords(roc_obj, x = "best", best.method = "youden",
                 ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity", "ppv", "npv"),
                 transpose = FALSE)[1, ]
  tibble(AUC = as.numeric(auc(roc_obj)), Threshold = best$threshold,
         Sensitivity = best$sensitivity, Specificity = best$specificity,
         PPV = best$ppv, NPV = best$npv,
         n_healthy = sum(label == 0), n_scar = sum(label == 1))
}

roc_data <- ds$all %>%
  filter(abs(Dist) <= ROC_HALF_WIDTH) %>%
  mutate(Label = as.integer(Dist > 0))

roc_results <- bind_rows(
  roc_data %>% group_by(Feature = "Voltage", Location, Electrode) %>%
    group_modify(~ run_roc(.x$PP, .x$Label)),
  roc_data %>% filter(Electrode != "Unipolar", !is.na(PFreq), PFreq > 0) %>%
    group_by(Feature = "Peak frequency", Location, Electrode) %>%
    group_modify(~ run_roc(.x$PFreq, .x$Label))
) %>% ungroup()
show(roc_results)
save_table(roc_results, "SuppResults7_ROC")
```

# Figures

```{r plot-helpers}
theme_panel <- theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
  theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16, colour = "grey30", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5)),
        panel.grid    = element_blank(),
        panel.border  = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5),
        legend.position = "none")
no_y_text <- theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())

# Per-patient LOESS curves (thin lines) and overall LOESS trend with 95% CI.
loess_by_patient <- function(d, y, span = 0.5) {
  d %>% group_by(Location, Electrode, patientID) %>% filter(n() > 5) %>%
    group_modify(function(g, key) tryCatch({
      fit  <- loess(reformulate("Dist", y), data = g, span = span, degree = 2)
      grid <- seq(min(g$Dist), max(g$Dist), length.out = 100)
      tibble(Dist = grid, value = predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(Dist = grid)))
    }, error = function(e) tibble(Dist = numeric(), value = numeric()))) %>%
    ungroup()
}
loess_overall <- function(d, y, span = 0.5) {
  d %>% group_by(Location, Electrode) %>% filter(n() > 10) %>%
    group_modify(function(g, key) {
      fit  <- loess(reformulate("Dist", y), data = g, span = span, degree = 2)
      grid <- seq(min(g$Dist), max(g$Dist), length.out = 200)
      pr   <- predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(Dist = grid), se = TRUE)
      tibble(Dist = grid, value = pr$fit, lo = pr$fit - 1.96 * pr$se.fit, hi = pr$fit + 1.96 * pr$se.fit)
    }) %>% ungroup()
}

panel_observed <- function(pts, y, loc, subtitle, title = NULL, ylim = NULL,
                           ybreaks = waiver(), boundary = FALSE) {
  pts    <- filter(pts, Location == loc)
  curves <- loess_by_patient(pts, y)
  trend  <- loess_overall(pts, y)
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = pts, aes(Dist, .data[[y]], colour = Electrode), alpha = 0.1, size = 0.6) +
    geom_line(data = curves, aes(Dist, value, colour = Electrode,
                                 group = interaction(Electrode, patientID)),
              linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_ribbon(data = trend, aes(Dist, ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = Electrode), alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_line(data = trend, aes(Dist, value, colour = Electrode), linewidth = 1.2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = COLORS) + scale_fill_manual(values = COLORS) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-10, 15, 5)) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = ybreaks) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-10, 15), ylim = ylim) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_panel
  if (boundary) {
    p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
      annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = 0, label = "Scar Boundary",
               size = 5, fontface = "italic", colour = "gray30")
  }
  if (loc == "Roof") p <- p + no_y_text
  p
}

panel_model <- function(pts, pred, y, loc, ylim, ybreaks) {
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = filter(pts, Location == loc), aes(Dist, .data[[y]], colour = Electrode),
               alpha = 0.1, size = 0.6) +
    geom_ribbon(data = filter(pred, Location == loc), aes(Dist, ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = Electrode), alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_line(data = filter(pred, Location == loc), aes(Dist, value, colour = Electrode), linewidth = 1.2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = COLORS) + scale_fill_manual(values = COLORS) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 15, 3)) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = ybreaks) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 15), ylim = ylim) +
    labs(subtitle = "Modeled (Post-Ablation)", x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_panel
  if (loc == "Roof") p <- p + no_y_text
  p
}

add_axis_labels <- function(grid, ylab, xlab = "Distance from Scar Boundary (mm)", size = 20) {
  y <- ggdraw() + draw_label(ylab, size = size, angle = 90)
  x <- ggdraw() + draw_label(xlab, size = size)
  plot_grid(plot_grid(y, grid, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.04, 1)), x,
            ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.03))
}
```

## Figure 5: normalized voltage within the effective field of view

Voltage predicted by the REML mixed model, normalized to the value at the scar boundary, and shown out to the effective field of view (Bayesian change point).

```{r figure5, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 16}
pct_labels   <- paste0(seq(0, 90, 10), "-", seq(10, 100, 10), "%")
disc_palette <- setNames(colorRampPalette(c("#EFF6FF", "#BFDBFE", "#60A5FA", "#2563EB",
                                            "#1D4ED8", "#1E3A8A"))(10), pct_labels)

make_semicircle <- function(loc, elec) {
  spec <- primary$specs %>% filter(Metric == "Voltage", Location == loc, Electrode == elec)
  fit <- spec$fit_reml[[1]]; model <- spec$model
  cp  <- efov %>% filter(Location == loc, Electrode == elec) %>% pull(EFOV)
  # reference point: boundary (d = 0) for exponential; smallest observed distance for power-law
  ref <- if (model == "Power-law") min(ds$volt$Dist) else 0
  b   <- lme4::fixef(fit)
  pred_fn <- if (model == "Power-law") function(d) exp(b[1] + b[2] * log(pmax(d, ref)))
             else function(d) exp(b[1] + b[2] * d)

  grid <- expand.grid(x = seq(0, 15, length.out = 400), y = seq(-15, 15, length.out = 400))
  grid$r   <- sqrt(grid$x^2 + grid$y^2)
  grid$pct <- ifelse(grid$r <= cp, pmin(pmax(pred_fn(grid$r) / pred_fn(ref) * 100, 0), 100), NA)
  grid$bin <- factor(cut(grid$pct, breaks = c(-1e-8, seq(10, 90, 10), 100 + 1e-8),
                         include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE, labels = pct_labels), levels = pct_labels)
  arc <- data.frame(t = seq(-pi / 2, pi / 2, length.out = 500)) %>% mutate(x = cp * cos(t), y = cp * sin(t))

  ggplot(grid, aes(x, y, fill = bin)) +
    geom_raster() +
    geom_path(data = arc, aes(x, y), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.7) +
    annotate("segment", x = 0, xend = 0, y = -15, yend = 15, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = disc_palette, limits = pct_labels, drop = FALSE, na.value = "white") +
    coord_fixed(xlim = c(-1, 16.5), ylim = c(-16.5, 16.5), clip = "off") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 15, 5)) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-15, 15, 5)) +
    labs(title = paste(elec, "-", if (loc == "Inferior") "Inferior Wall" else "Roof"), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 26) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 25, hjust = 0.5), panel.grid = element_blank(),
          panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "grey70"), legend.position = "none",
          axis.text = element_text(size = 20), plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10))
}

semi_legend <- get_legend(
  ggplot(data.frame(x = 1, y = 1:10, bin = factor(pct_labels, levels = pct_labels)), aes(x, y, fill = bin)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = disc_palette, limits = pct_labels, name = "Relative\nValue") +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1, reverse = TRUE)) + theme_void() +
    theme(legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "cm"), legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 25, face = "bold"))
)

semi_grid <- plot_grid(plotlist = lapply(ELECTRODES, function(e) lapply(LOCATIONS, make_semicircle, elec = e)) %>%
                         unlist(recursive = FALSE), ncol = 2)
figure5 <- plot_grid(
  add_axis_labels(semi_grid, "Distance (mm)", "Effective Field of View (mm)", size = 25),
  semi_legend, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(1, 0.18))

figure5
save_figure(figure5, "Figure5_effective_field_of_view", width = 11, height = 16)
```
